rows.note: Use 吼 as the all-purpose choice for a deep roar or a forceful bellow, whether from an animal or a person.

example.english: That bull will bellow whenever it gets angry.
example.traditional: 嗰隻牛一發脾氣就會吼。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 ngau4 jat1 faat3 pei4 hei3 zau6 wui5 hau2

rows.note: Choose 大嗌 for a person shouting loudly when the deep quality of the voice is supplied by context rather than by the verb.

example.english: When they get angry, they bellow so loudly that the whole floor can hear them.
example.traditional: 佢一嬲就大嗌，成層樓都聽到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 nau1 zau6 daai6 aai3 sing4 cang4 lau4 dou1 teng1 dou2
